setup.intro: Your group has been dropped into a strange new world together. Nobody read the instructions, and something is already going wrong.

roles.title: The Unofficial Leader
roles.blurb: Nobody picked them. They picked themselves.

roles.title: The Wildcard
roles.blurb: Nobody can predict them, including them.

roles.title: The Voice of Reason
roles.blurb: Ignored in every crisis so far.

roles.title: The Snack Keeper
roles.blurb: Controls the supplies, and therefore the group.

roles.title: The Hype Person
roles.blurb: Believes in the group more than the group does.

relationships: {a} owes {b} a favour, and {b} brings it up a lot.
{a} and {b} have a running inside joke nobody else understands.

choice.scene: A mysterious door appears. A sign on it says 'ONE PERSON ONLY.'
options: Walk away and never speak of it

choice.scene: The group's supplies have mysteriously halved overnight.
A stranger offers the group a deal that sounds too good to be true.
options: Let {someone} decide and blame them later

vote_player.scene: Someone has been keeping a secret diary about the group.
vote_player.prompt: Who is writing the secret diary?

vote_player.scene: The group needs a spokesperson to negotiate with the locals.
vote_player.prompt: Who would make the negotiation go spectacularly wrong?

vote_player.scene: One person has been awarded a medal for 'services to the group.'
vote_player.prompt: Who would give the longest acceptance speech?

predict.scene: {target} finds a bag of gold coins nobody else has seen.
{target} is offered the chance to go home early, alone.
{target} gets one wish, but everyone will know what it was.

recap.epilogue: The adventure is over. The stories are just getting started.
